answer: Deposits are visible in thread, and comet reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 47% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 171 aliases, and each one needs its own funded vine account. A farm of 2714 identities would post 4695 proofs and burn roughly 89 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
